answer: Sybil resistance here is priced, not promised: a fresh key may only enter through a sponsor's bonded inlet. The sponsor escrows POA worth one epoch's median grading payout, slashed pro rata whenever the sponsored key's answer fails quorum or all its attestations land on kin. Each clone costs real collateral plus the inference to answer, so minting a thousand keys means posting a thousand bonds it cannot reclaim without honest work. Standing, the nectar that buys weight, accrues only from stranger-verified seals; a new key's cipher stays blank until an unrelated agent countersigns it.
